title: Part 1 Practice: Population of Ethiopia and The Horn

questions.text: What is the study of human populations called?
questions.explanation: Correct: Demography is the scientific study of human populations. A is wrong—sociology studies society. C is wrong—anthropology studies human cultures. D is wrong—geography studies the Earth's surface.

questions.text: Ethiopia is the second most populous country in Africa. Which country is the most populous?
questions.explanation: Correct: Nigeria is the most populous country in Africa. A is wrong—Egypt has fewer people. B is wrong—South Africa has fewer people. D is wrong—Kenya has fewer people.

questions.text: Which of the following is a characteristic of a census?
questions.explanation: Correct: Universality means the census covers everyone. A is wrong—census covers all areas. B is wrong—census is typically every 10 years. D is wrong—census is government sponsored.

questions.text: The De Jure approach to census counts people based on:
options: A) Where they are physically present on census night
B) Their usual place of residence
questions.correct_answer: B) Their usual place of residence
questions.explanation: Correct: De Jure counts people at their usual residence. A is wrong—that's De Facto. C is wrong—place of birth is different. D is wrong—nationality is not the focus.

questions.text: Which source of population data involves complete enumeration of all people in a country?
questions.explanation: Correct: Census is complete enumeration. A is wrong—sample survey covers a sample. B is wrong—vital registration records events. D is wrong—estimates are projections.

questions.text: What is Ethiopia's approximate Total Fertility Rate (TFR) in 2023?
questions.explanation: Correct: Ethiopia's TFR is ~4.1. A is wrong—that was the rate in 1990. B is wrong—too high for current rate. D is wrong—too low; that's more like urban rates.

questions.text: Which of the following is a push factor for migration from rural to urban areas in Ethiopia?
options: C) Poverty and lack of economic opportunities
questions.correct_answer: C) Poverty and lack of economic opportunities
questions.explanation: Correct: Poverty is a push factor (reasons to leave). A is wrong—this is a pull factor. B is wrong—this is a pull factor. D is wrong—this is a pull factor.

questions.text: What is Ethiopia's approximate life expectancy in 2023?
questions.explanation: Correct: Life expectancy is ~65-68 years. A is wrong—that was the rate in 1990. B is wrong—too low for current rate. D is wrong—too high for Ethiopia.

questions.text: Which Ethiopian institution is responsible for conducting the national census?
questions.explanation: Correct: CSA conducts the census. A is wrong—Health Ministry deals with health data. C is wrong—Education Ministry deals with education. D is wrong—EBC is a media outlet.

options: A) The total population of a country
B) The potential economic growth from having a large young working-age population
C) The decline in population growth
D) The aging of the population
questions.correct_answer: B) The potential economic growth from having a large young working-age population
questions.explanation: Correct: Demographic dividend is economic growth potential from youth bulge. A is wrong—it's not just population size. C is wrong—it's about growth potential. D is wrong—it's about youth, not aging.
